FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 130
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Jim Hill
Analyst: Michael Russo Date: 01/27/2026
House Bill 130 as introduced would allow the employees of the St. Clair County DAY Program,
Incorporated, to participate in the Teachers' Retirement System (TRS), provided the program
pay all costs necessary to fund the provisions of this bill, as determined by the TRS actuary.
This bill would not otherwise affect state or local funding.
